changes.name: FreshIslandResetV44
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")

local function hideExpansionPart(p)
 if not p:IsA("BasePart") then return end
 if p.Name:match("^L%d+_") or p.Name:find("Expansion") or p.Name=="Bridge" or p.Name=="TreasureIsland" then
  p.Transparency=1
  p.CanCollide=false
 end
end

-- Every fresh server starts with expansion land hidden.
local directional=world:FindFirstChild("DirectionalExpansions")
if directional then
 for _,v in ipairs(directional:GetDescendants()) do hideExpansionPart(v) end
end
for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do hideExpansionPart(v) end

-- No saving: every player starts at stage 0 each session.
local function resetPlayer(player)
 local stage=player:WaitForChild("IslandStage")
 stage.Value=0
end
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(resetPlayer,p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(resetPlayer)

print("Fresh-session island reset loaded")
